## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/_store/sync.py:111-344` (`_do_reconverge` / `_union_merge`, ~170 LOC) and `src/rebar/_store/push_recovery.py:128-354` (`_recover_non_fast_forward` and helpers, ~225 LOC) both: canonicalise, apply the epoch guard, merge the remote tickets ref under the store lock, classify the merge abort, quarantine untracked overwrites, recover local changes, retry once. They differ in two quarantine implementations (only `push_recovery._quarantine_untracked_paths:236` has the `??` status fence), two merge messages, restore-from-HEAD versus stash-commit for dirty trees, fetch retry on one side only, and unrelated-histories handling on one side only. Bugs `sulfuryl-suicidal-osprey` and `small-delicious-loris` were fixes landing in one of the two paths.

## Approach
Add `src/rebar/_store/merge_recovery.py` with `merge_remote(tracker, remote_ref, *, git, message, dirty_strategy) -> MergeResult` implementing epoch guard, merge, abort classification (via the git outcome classifier if landed, else the existing predicates), quarantine with the `??` fence, local-change recovery, single retry. `sync` and `push_recovery` become thin callers; `push_recovery` keeps its late-bound `core` seam by passing `git=` explicitly so `tests` can still patch `push._git`. Guard test: `git merge` of a tickets ref is invoked from `merge_recovery.py` only (`# merge-ok:` escape).


## Guard construction
Follow the guard-test construction rule in the parent epic `airborne-wellloved-kingfisher`: owner module exempt, match the constituent conjunction or AST shape named in Approach (or the definition count where no distinctive atom exists), `# <construct>-ok: <reason>` escape marker, and behaviour pinned only by the named existing tests.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_store/merge_recovery.py` (new), `src/rebar/_store/sync.py`, `src/rebar/_store/push_recovery.py`, `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py` (reconverge caller), `tests/unit/store/test_merge_recovery.py` (new).

## Testing
Happy path: clean merge. Edge: untracked overwrite → quarantined and merged; local change → restored; unrelated histories → the existing ff-adopt path. Pinning: `tests/unit/test_store_sync_reconverge.py`, `tests/unit/test_sync_union_recovery.py`, `tests/unit/test_push_recovery_untracked.py`, `tests/unit/test_push_retry_stash_pop.py`, `tests/unit/test_commit_and_push_tickets_branch*.py`, `tests/unit/test_push_strict*.py` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both callers produce byte-identical tracker state to today on the pinning suites; checked by those suites passing with no assertion edits.
- [ ] Net change across `sync.py` + `push_recovery.py` + `merge_recovery.py` is at least −150 non-test lines; checked by `git show --numstat`.
- [ ] The guard test passes; checked in the default `Verified` tier.
